data.description: Live in One of Dubai’s Most Prestigious Areas
data.long_description:
Welcome to Legado by Prescott, a true architectural masterpiece nestled in the vibrant heart of JVC, Dubai. This luxury high-rise development features 2 basement levels, a grand ground floor, five podiums, and 26 floors of exquisitely designed residences. With modern plumbing, elegant interiors, and panoramic views through floor to ceiling windows, every detail has been meticulously curated to offer an elevated urban living experience.

But Legado isn’t just about beautiful homes, it’s a complete lifestyle destination. Enjoy exclusive access to amenities like an infinity edge pool, a meditation area, basketball court, and a cutting edge fitness studio. Families are catered to with a dedicated kids' pool, playground, and water park, while adults can unwind at the coffee bar or library. Here, luxury isn’t just a feature, it’s a way of life.
